main.description: Which app.activitytracker.actor.privacyZones save every one of the athlete's activity polylines has been trimmed by and sent. A client whose zones revision differs re-trims the athlete's activities from their tracks, then writes this. Lives only in the athlete's self space, never in the repo; the AppView ignores it. Kept apart from privacyZones so finishing a re-trim never overwrites a zone saved meanwhile.

revision.description: The privacyZones revision the polylines were trimmed by.
